interview.answer: The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. What do you want to tackle first, Mara?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Leo: Let’s start with the list of needed repairs and who can handle each one.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge things for the repair drive—who still needs to be looped in?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: Uh, I think a couple folks still need the heads-up, but I’m a bit fuzzy on who exactly. I can check and get back to you.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: No worries — just send me the names when you have them, and I’ll help with the follow-up.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: I can sort through what I have and bring any tools, tape, screws, and sturdy boxes I can find.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: That’s super helpful, Hana — thank you. I’ll keep connecting folks and we can match each repair to the right person.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: Great — send me the repair list when you can, and I’ll double-check what I’ve got before I bring it over.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Gus: Yep — we’re still set for the community shed at 3 PM on Saturday, and I’ve got a few tools folks can borrow if they need them.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Jules: Great, that’s helpful — I can start matching the repairs to people and keep the list moving. If you want, I can also help loop in anyone who still needs a heads-up.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: That’d be great, Jules — thanks for helping spread the word and keep the list moving. I’ll bring the tools and be ready at the shed.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rosa: Yes — just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep everything organized and make sure folks know where to bring their requests.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Rosa — that’s great news. I’ll help spread the word and loop in anyone who still needs to be connected.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. If anyone has questions, send them my way and I’ll keep everything on track.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Jules: Sure — who still needs to be looped in, and what should I tackle first?

events.text: Mara: Please loop in Sam and Rosa, and start with the repair list so we can match each task to a person and timing.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll loop in Sam and Rosa, and I’ll start matching the repair list to each task and timing.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: I think we still need to loop in a couple folks, but I might be missing someone. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

events.text: Jules: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. If you remember who’s still out of the loop, I can help spread the word.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll try to remember who’s still out of the loop and send them your way.

events.text: Jules: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch. I can help make sure everyone hears the update.
